//: AppSail config for the Catalyst-MANAGED Python runtime path (no Docker).
//port: Catalyst injects the listen port via X_ZOHO_CATALYST_LISTEN_PORT; the startup command binds uvicorn to it (default 9000 for local runs).
//command: Data is pre-built and committed (backend/data/processed/api/*.json), so the runtime just serves it - no pipeline run at startup.

env_variables.//CRIME_CORS_ORIGINS: Your Slate frontend origin. Leave unset to use the built-in allowlist (localhost + Catalyst domains). Do NOT set '*' - that lets any website read the API.
env_variables.//CRIME_API_KEYS: 'key:role,...' with roles viewer|analyst|admin. Enforces RBAC on /api/fir/offenders, /api/fir/network and /api/intelligence/*. Unset = those endpoints are public.
env_variables.//CRIME_TRUSTED_HOSTS: Comma-separated Host allowlist; blocks Host-header poisoning. '*' disables the check.
env_variables.//CRIME_DOCS: 1 to expose /docs and /openapi.json. Defaults off once CRIME_API_KEYS is set.
